description.value: Beaches Grocery is a small but well-positioned convenience and general store located right beside Chesterman Beach, one of Tofino's most popular stretches of coastline. It offers a compact selection of groceries and general goods to beachgoers, surfers, and visitors exploring the outer edges of Tofino. For touring cyclists, it represents a practical resupply point on the southern end of town near the beach access roads.
